aspect: Suspension first, review later, if at all
description: Accounts are limited or closed pending review, with funds held. The seller has delivered the work; the platform holds the money; the appeal is a form.
energy_note: Work delivered, money held, nobody to call.

aspect: The 20-30% that never reaches the freelancer
description: On Upwork, Palestinian and Nigerian freelancers alike lose a further 20-30% of earnings to currency-exchange intermediaries on top of platform fees, because the standard payout rails are unavailable.
money_note: Annual loss to intermediaries at typical freelance income.
energy_note: A quarter of every invoice, to the plumbing.

aspect: So the ceiling is the payment method, not the skill
description: A business cannot scale past the rail it can be paid on. The constraint is not talent, market or capital.
energy_note: A company that cannot grow larger than a bank transfer.

description: Ninety-one completed jobs, 4.9 average, two years of history. The account is restricted on a Tuesday pending identity review. She uploads the same NIN she uploaded at signup. On day thirty-one it is restored with no explanation and her ranking has reset.
energy_note: Two years of reputation, reset by a review.

description: The platform will only pay out to accounts in supported countries. She uses a cousin's account in Canada. In November the cousin's bank asks the cousin about the pattern of incoming payments, and the cousin, reasonably, asks her to stop.
energy_note: A workaround that ended with a phone call to Toronto.
